mapper.select: SELECT ar.report_no AS accident_number, ar.accident_status, pad.document_id, pad.submission_status, ROUND((pad.damage_amount * pad.fault_ratio::numeric / 100), 2) AS final_payment_amount FROM accident_report ar LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT document_id, submission_status, damage_amount, fault_ratio, created_at FROM payment_approval_document WHERE report_no = ar.report_no ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) pad ON true WHERE ar.report_no = #{accidentNumber}

SELECT o.objection_id, o.accident_number, ar.accident_status, pad.document_id, pad.submission_status, ROUND((pad.damage_amount * pad.fault_ratio::numeric / 100), 2) AS final_payment_amount, o.claimant_name, o.claimant_phone, o.objection_reason, o.requested_action, o.employee_no, o.objection_status, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.reviewed_at, o.completed_at FROM objection o JOIN accident_report ar ON ar.report_no = o.accident_number LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT document_id, submission_status, damage_amount, fault_ratio, created_at FROM payment_approval_document WHERE report_no = o.accident_number ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) pad ON true WHERE o.accident_number = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO objection ( objection_id, accident_number, claimant_name, claimant_phone, objection_reason, requested_action, employee_no, objection_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{objectionId}, #{accidentNumber}, #{claimantName}, #{claimantPhone}, #{objectionReason}, #{requestedAction}, #{employeeNo}, #{objectionStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
